name: Luciella
source:
A senior member of the Demon Lord's Army. Shinigami. A dark-hearted, taciturn beauty.
She gives off a fragile and weak vibe, but the Reaper's Scythe she carries is imbued with a strong power.
As long as it is in her hand, she is invincible.
She feels lonely because she can only take life away
